def to_file(self, filename=None, write_style=True):
        """
        >>> p = Preso()
        >>> z = p.to_file('/tmp/foo.odp')
        >>> sorted(z.ls('/'))
        ['META-INF/manifest.xml', 'content.xml', 'meta.xml', 'mimetype', 'settings.xml', 'styles.xml']
        """
        if filename is None:
            filename = self.filename
        if not filename.endswith('.odp'):
            filename += '.odp'
        self.filename = filename
        self.write_style = write_style
        try:
            self.zip.close()
        except:
            pass
        self.zip = ZipFile(filename, 'w', compression=ZIP_DEFLATED)
        self.zip.writestr('mimetype', 'application/vnd.oasis.opendocument.presentation')
        self.zip.writestr('meta.xml', self.meta.to_xml())
        self.zip.writestr('settings.xml', self.settings.to_xml())
        self.zip.writestr('styles.xml', self.styles.to_xml())
        self.zip.writestr('content.xml', self.content.to_xml())
        if write_style:
            self.zip.writestr('styles.xml', self.styles.to_xml())
        self.zip.close()
